say:2:1820132001:1.text: That inn owner's such a scammer...
say:2:1820132001:1.source_cn: 呜呜，诺珐斯的旅店商人好黑……

say:3:1820132002:1.text: What happened? Did he pick on you? I swear I'll tear his arm off...
say:3:1820132002:1.source_cn: 怎么，他敢欺负你吗？等着，姨妈现在就去把他的胳膊掰下来——

say:4:1820132003:1.text: No, he didn't... He offered the same rate to everyone.
say:4:1820132003:1.source_cn: ——不不不，他没有欺负我！他给所有人的汇率都是一样的。

say:5:1820132004:1.text: But that rate? Practically daylight robbery! Someone tried to haggle with him, and he had the nerve to insist it was fair! He said the tavern next door was the real scam!
say:5:1820132004:1.source_cn: 但他给出的汇率实在高得吓人！有人想讲讲价，那个商人还大...

say:6:1820132005:1.text: Some customers weren't buying it and marched straight to the tavern at the end of Crescent Street to see what they were charging.
say:6:1820132005:1.source_cn: 有人不服，当场就打算去月弯街尽头的那个酒馆问问价。

say:7:1820132006:1.text: I'd have joined them if I didn't need to rush back...
say:7:1820132006:1.source_cn: 要不是我赶时间，非得跟着他们一起去一趟……

say:8:1820132007:1.text: Vivi, you'd better stay away from that tavern.
say:8:1820132007:1.source_cn: 薇薇娅，不要随便去那个酒馆哦。

say:9:1820132008:1.text: The living frequent that area, and the tavern even openly accepts Lightbearer gold.
say:9:1820132008:1.source_cn: 那附近常有活人出没，酒馆甚至可以正当光明地使用耀光金币。

say:10:1820132009:1.text: Yet, Bantus never takes action against it. That place has to be backed by some powerful force we don't know about.
say:10:1820132009:1.source_cn: 如此毫不遮掩，班题斯却从不管。那地方不简单，肯定背靠着...

say:11:1820132010:1.text: Promise me you'll steer clear of it while you're in Novaris, alright, my dear Vivi?
say:11:1820132010:1.source_cn: 在诺珐斯期间，一定要尽量避开那个地方。记住了吗，我亲爱...

say:13:1820132012:1.text: Anyway, I've got enough iron for that tea set now!
say:13:1820132012:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，我已经换到了足够的黑铁币了。老板，请帮我把...

say:15:1820132014:1.text: The party doesn't begin until the <style="highlight">full moon</style> rises, so we still have time to visit other places.
